title.narrative: UNMAS: Capacity Enhancement of the Palestinian National Authority to Deliver Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)-mainstreamed Explosive Ordnance Risk Education (EORE) in the West Bank (New Zealand 23-24)

description.narrative:
This UN Mine Action (UNMAS) project aims to deliver actions 28-32 of the Oslo Action Plan (as adopted 2019), through building national capacity to deliver effective and relevant risk education that is sensitive to gender, age, disability and that takes the diverse needs and experiences of people in affected communities into account. The project is in line with the UN Mine Action Strategy (2019-2023), and the UNMAS Palestine PS (2020-2022). The project’s objectives align with the Palestinian National Policy Agenda 2017-2022 for supporting sustainable development through building resilient communities. Moreover, this project also aligns with women’s political empowerment as an accelerator to the SDGs encompassing women’s leadership and decision-making and SCR 1325; and elimination of violence and harmful practices. As such, the programme is also aligned with the United Nations Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF). In line with the above, the project aims to educate at-risk individuals about safe behaviour around explosive hazards while mainstreaming gender in order to save lives.

UNOPS provides project management, human resources, procurement and contract management services as well as innovation, risk management and oversight support to the UN Mine Action Service’s (UNMAS) around the world.
